title: Health Regen - Configurable
author: oOCamilleOo
summary: Configurable health regeneration for humans and vampires. Stops adding healing at full recoverable health or the current vampire segment limit, with optional combat and lost-segment recovery.

file.name: Health Regen - Configurable
file.description: Human and vampire health regeneration with separate 0–5% rates, optional combat regeneration and optional vampire segment recovery. Both rates default to 1.5% outside combat. Recovery respects the current vampire segment limit by default.

requirements.name: UE4SS for BoD
requirements.note: Framecore 2b required by the native helper.
